## Gap ID
API-008

## Source
gap-analysis-api-interface

## Description
OSimFlow has no Python or Ruby client SDK. All automation requires raw HTTP calls or CLI invocations. openstudio-server provides both Ruby gem and Python client libraries.

## Evidence
- `osimflow/` — no client SDK package
- No `osimflow-client` PyPI package
- No Ruby gem

## Severity
Major

## Recommended Mitigation
Publish a minimal `osimflow-client` Python package on PyPI. Include:
- Campaign creation/deletion/status
- Result retrieval
- Variable and measure listing

## Labels
gap-analysis, api, sdk, client, major
